spec_family.name: Exterior Porch Ceiling Repaint (Combined Assessment + Prep + Prime + Finish)
spec_family.description: Combined condition assessment + prep + prime + finish repaint spec for previously painted exterior porch ceiling surfaces on residential homes. Covers 2 substrate material types (wood T&G/beadboard/plywood, fiber cement). Porch ceiling is the underside of a covered porch/portico/breezeway roof — ALL work is overhead with ~25-35% productivity penalty baked into base rates. Key differences from soffit RP: spray ALWAYS eligible (no vent constraint), beadboard panel type, lower access height (8-10 ft typical), more ceiling-mounted fixtures (fans, pendant lights). Mildew/algae is the #1 degradation concern. 4 substrate states drive condition-dependent prep intensity and primer selection. SF-based measurement. QT2-QT4. Single mobilization.

includes: Condition assessment (visual inspect, ASTM D3359 adhesion test, mildew/algae assessment as porch ceiling priority check, moisture probe on wood panels, caulk condition assessment per 'Think Like a Water Drop')
EPA Lead-Safe RRP evaluation and containment for pre-1978 homes (overhead scraping on porch ceiling is HIGH RISK for lead dust exposure)
Low-pressure wash (500-800 PSI max, fan tip, mildew-removal detergent) — NEVER power wash porch ceiling
Mildew/algae biocide treatment (#1 degradation mechanism for sheltered overhead surfaces — painting over mildew = guaranteed adhesion failure)
Chalk remediation pre-treatment for SS_EXT_CHALKING condition
Scrape and feather failing/peeling paint overhead
Degloss/scuff existing sound paint (chemical deglosser or 150-grit mechanical scuff)
Caulk assessment and repair at panel joints and ceiling-to-fascia/wall junctions per 'Think Like a Water Drop' protocol
State-driven primer selection and application (chalk-binding for SS_EXT_CHALKING, acrylic stain-block for SS_EXT_FAILING_PAINT/PEELING wood, alkali-resistant for SS_EXT_FAILING_PAINT/PEELING FC)
Standard field finish coat application — brush_roll or spray (both ALWAYS eligible, no vent constraint)
Interstage inspection and sanding (QT4 full 220-grit intercoat sand, QT3 spot only)
T&G and beadboard groove brush-back when spray applied (work paint into grooves while wet)
Cut-in at fascia, wall, and column junctions
Porch floor protection (CRITICAL for overhead drip fallout and scraping debris)
Ceiling-mounted fixture masking (ceiling fans, pendant lights, recessed cans)
Adjacent fascia/wall/siding masking (MANDATORY in RP — surfaces almost always already finished)
Customer walkthrough with maintenance recommendations (mildew-resistant formulation, annual inspection)

site_condition_rules.notes: Porch ceilings typically at 8-10 ft (ground or step ladder). Lower than soffit.
Pre-1978 + lead-positive activates MOD_RRP_EXT_CONTAINMENT and FAC_PCRP_RRP (2.0x).
MC > 15% is STOP WORK. Active moisture = do not proceed until source resolved.
Mildew is #1 degradation mechanism for porch ceiling. MUST treat before coating.

cross_spec_coordination.deduplication_note: MOD_RRP_EXT_CONTAINMENT shared across all exterior RP specs.
cross_spec_coordination.shared_session_note: Porch ceiling RP may run alongside SF_TRIM_EXT_RP (fascia) and SF_SOFFIT_EXT_RP. Porch floor protection is THIS spec's responsibility. Fascia masking is THIS spec's responsibility.
coordination_notes: Caulk at ceiling-to-fascia and ceiling-to-wall junctions is THIS spec's responsibility.
RRP containment is shared — do not duplicate per-elevation containment tasks.
Porch floor protection is distinct from landscape protection (soffit spec's domain).
Edge work at soffit-porch ceiling transition: minimal when same color (typical).

sequencing_notes.production_sequence: Setup (floor protect + furniture + fixture mask + fascia/wall/siding mask + equipment) -> RRP containment (if pre-1978) -> Assess (visual + adhesion + mildew + moisture + caulk) -> Prep (wash + 24-48h dry + mildew biocide + chalk remediation + scrape/feather + degloss/scuff + dust cleanup) -> Prime (state-driven, FAIR/POOR only) -> Caulk repair (AFTER prime) -> Finish 1 (cut-in + brush/roll or spray + groove brush-back) -> Interstage (inspect + sand QT4 + touch-up + dust) -> Finish 2 (QT3/QT4 only) -> Final inspect + Touch-up -> Protection teardown -> Equipment clean -> Site cleanup -> Customer walkthrough
sequencing_notes.key_prohibitions: NO power washing porch ceiling. NO painting over mildew. NO skipping chalk-binding primer on SS_EXT_CHALKING. NO RRP without containment. NO scraping without feathering. NO caulking before primer.

relationships.notes: First exterior porch ceiling RP spec. NC sibling has 31 tasks. RP has 41 tasks (10 additional for assessment, condition-driven prep, state-driven primer, customer walkthrough). Context prefix PCRP. Closely mirrors soffit RP but simpler (no vent constraint, no vinyl substrate).
